data.name: Aaditya Rawat
intro: **Web3 Protocol Engineer | AI Systems Builder | Security Researcher**.
I build production-grade AI systems and Web3 infrastructure. My work focuses on autonomous agents, DeFi protocols, Solidity & Move smart contracts, and modern full-stack applications.

featured.name: Rapid7 Metasploit Framework
body: Contributed production-quality improvements to the Metasploit Framework, enhancing network protocol handling, RPC services, and framework maintainability.

Developed unit tests and successfully merged multiple pull requests into the production open-source codebase including fixes for msfrpcd JSON-RPC SSL certificate checks and MS SQL Server 2022 stored procedure execution errors.

previous.name: Django CMS
body: Developed comprehensive integration and regression tests to ensure reliable middleware behavior and long-term framework stability.
Co-authored core fix/feature for django-cms ecosystem (earned Pair Extraordinaire).

previous.name: Various Projects (Python, Typescript)
body: Merged 3 pull requests across open-source projects involving Python, Solidity, and TypeScript ecosystems during Hacktoberfest.
Contributed 500+ lines of code including real-time network protocol handling and blockchain contract version-history retrieval features.

previous.name: .EXE Technical Club, NIT Hamirpur
body: Contributed to initiatives that helped the club secure the Best Technical Club award at Nimbus 2025.
Collaborated on a CyberSecurity Project with the technical club members.

previous.name: Flow Sentinel
body: Built and deployed an autonomous DeFi yield protocol on Flow blockchain enabling self-managed vaults with liquid staking, yield farming, and arbitrage strategies.
Engineered a 4-layer MEV protection framework combining commit-reveal execution, VRF-randomized delays, price-deviation guards, and execution-queue randomization.
Authored 9 production-grade Cadence smart contracts with secure vault architecture, oracle-integrated analytics, and dual wallet support (Flow Wallet & MetaMask).
Selected for the Flow Grant DAO on DoraHacks, securing $300 in funding (10,000 $FLOW) from Flow Blockchain to develop the protocol into a production-ready decentralized application.

Featured in Flow Blockchain's Official Blog: [From the Himalayas to Rebuilding Trust in DeFi: The Story Behind Flow Sentinel](https://flow.com/post/from-the-himalayas-to-rebuilding-trust-in-defi-the-story-behind-flow-sentinel)

previous.name: AgentMD
body: Built an AI engineering platform offering 150+ production-ready presets across 19 categories, standardizing AI engineering workflows for development teams.
Developed a cross-editor extension for VS Code, Cursor, and Kiro with preset discovery, live preview, one-click installation, and automatic project-stack detection.
Engineered a zero-setup NPX CLI for installing individual presets or full categories directly into any developer project.
Designed a modular architecture supporting extensible preset registries, AI workflow automation, and frictionless developer onboarding.

previous.name: GhostPay
body: Built a privacy-first Web3 payment platform enabling seamless digital payments through embedded wallets and gasless onboarding.
Integrated Google OAuth, the Sui SDK, and mysten/dapp-kit with secure wallet abstraction to simplify Web3 onboarding for non crypto-native users.
Implemented decentralized document storage using Walrus alongside secure payment workflows and identity verification.
Designed modular payment infrastructure supporting programmable transactions, AI-agent integrations, and scalable Web3 commerce.

previous.name: Argus
body: Built a blockchain observability and security platform for real-time monitoring of smart contract execution.
Developed transaction-analysis pipelines to detect anomalous behavior, exploit patterns, and security risks on-chain.
Integrated SigNoz for distributed tracing, metrics collection, and operational monitoring across blockchain services.
Implemented scalable backend services in Go with modular APIs and containerized deployment.
